task: Design critique of the Revise tab (Director's Console) found real bugs and design gaps. Fixed all 2 Critical items and all 5 Warning items in one contained pass: keyboard-dead segments (role="button" divs with no onKeyDown, so Tab+Enter/Space silently did nothing), no resting-state/touch affordance for the clickable segments, segment boundaries visually indistinguishable from paragraph breaks, focus not moving into the textarea on edit start, no Escape-to-cancel/Cmd+Enter-to-save, a save-button color-pairing violation (--surface paired with --accent instead of the --on-action token .btn-primary already establishes), and no persistent editability hint in the topbar.

frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/compone.summary: CRITICAL #1 (keyboard activation): added `handleSegmentKeyDown` firing `handleStartEdit` on Enter or Space (`preventDefault` on Space to stop page scroll), wired via `onKeyDown` on the segment div; added a descriptive `aria-label` (`getSegmentAriaLabel` — 'Edit: {first ~8 words}…') so screen readers get more than a bare 'button'. CRITICAL #2 (icon cue): added a `PenLine` icon (`revise-text-view__edit-icon`) inside each segment, shown via CSS on `:hover`/`:focus-within` so keyboard focus gets the same non-color cue as mouse hover (WCAG 1.4.1). Warning #4 (focus-into-textarea): added a `textareaRef` + a `useEffect` keyed on `editingId` that focuses the textarea and places the caret at the end of the text as soon as an edit starts. Warning #5 (Escape/Cmd+Enter): added `handleTextareaKeyDown` — Escape calls the same `handleCancelEdit` the Cancel button uses; Cmd+Enter/Ctrl+Enter calls `handleCommit` (mirroring the Save button's disabled guard: no-op while saving or when the draft is empty). Warning #7 (persistent hint): topbar now renders a quiet `revise-tool__hint` caption ('Click any passage to edit — saving re-renders that segment.') in place of the editing banner while not editing.

frontend/src/theme/components.css.summary: CRITICAL #2 (resting-state/touch affordance): `.revise-text-view__segment` gained a persistent `border-left: 2px solid var(--border-muted)` so extent/clickability is visible before any interaction; `:hover`/`:focus-within` now also intensify `border-color`/`border-left-color` to `var(--border)` (previously background-wash only) and reveal the new `.revise-text-view__edit-icon` (opacity 0→1, transition-based, not color-only). Warning #3 (segment vs. paragraph boundaries): reduced `.revise-text-view`'s inter-segment `gap` from 8px to 3px so consecutive same-paragraph segments read less like separate paragraphs, while the border-left tick keeps individual segment extents legible. Warning #6 (token pairing): `.revise-text-view__save-btn` now pairs `color: var(--on-action)` with `background: var(--accent)`, matching `.btn-primary`'s `--action-primary`/`--on-action` convention (was incorrectly paired with `var(--surface)`). Added `.revise-tool__hint` (quiet caption style, `var(--text-muted)`, 0.7rem) for the new topbar hint.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/ChapterEditor/.summary: Added a 'keyboard activation and shortcuts' describe block: Enter and Space on a segment start editing; the segment carries a descriptive aria-label; the textarea receives focus when editing starts; Escape cancels without calling the API; Cmd+Enter commits (updateSegment then generateSegments). Added a 'save button token pairing' describe block that reads `src/theme/components.css` directly (via `node:fs`/`node:path` — jsdom in this project doesn't process the theme stylesheet, no `css: true` in vitest.config.ts) and asserts the `.revise-text-view__save-btn` rule pairs `var(--on-action)`, not `var(--surface)`. R1 revert-check performed: with the pre-fix `index.tsx`/`components.css` restored via `git stash`, 7 of the new/updated tests failed for the expected reasons (no keyboard handler, no focus-on-edit, no Escape/Cmd+Enter handling, wrong CSS token) before the fix was restored.

flow_impact: No prop/contract changes — ReviseTool remains zero-prop (INV-1), resolves context via useBookDataContext()/useSearchParams() as before. No backend/API changes. Do-not-touch files (Cast/Booth/Write tool files, DirectorsConsole/index.tsx, DirtyGuardContext.tsx) were left untouched; DirtyGuardContext wiring (already-fixed silent-draft-loss issue) was read-only reference, not modified. All Critical and Warning items from the critique were completed in this pass — none deferred.
